item.title: #5 Tigers sweep Governors State, reach 12-0 on the season
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. — The #5 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team extended its perfect season on Saturday, sweeping Governors State University in a 3-0 battle inside Gosser Gymnasium. The Tigers dominated the court in a high-powered offensive contest to overpower the Jaguars in straight sets (25-20, 25-22, 25-14).

item.title: Second-half surge ends short as Tigers drop nailbiter to #1 Freed-Hardeman
item.description: HENDERSON, Tenn. – Tiger basketball closed out its road trip against the NAIA's top-ranked team, the Freed-Hardeman University Lions, at the Brewer Sports Center on Saturday afternoon. Despite a valiant second-half surge and a 29-point masterclass from Dalton Kramer, Campbellsville's comeback fell just short as they dropped the Mid-South Conference contest, 75-64.

item.title: Tiger Wrestling has 14 Academic All-Conference honorees
item.description: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. – The Campbellsville University men's wrestling team collected 14 student-athletes earning Academic All-Conference honors this season.

item.title: Tigers cap relocated weekend with emphatic sweep over Goshen, Kentucky Christian
item.description: CAMPTON, Ky. – The Campbellsville University baseball team concluded its relocated weekend slate in dominant fashion on Saturday, sweeping a neutral-site doubleheader at Wolfe County High School. The Tigers offense erupted to run-rule Goshen College 12-1 before relying on a complete-game gem from Tristin Crusenberry to defeat Kentucky Christian University 6-2, improving to 6-2 on the young season.

item.title: Tigers crown 3 National Champions, haul All-American honors at NCCAA Championships
item.description: CEDARVILLE, Ohio. — The Campbellsville University Track & Field teams delivered a definitive performance at the NCCAA Indoor National Championships this weekend, bringing home three national titles, a sweeping collection of All-American honors, and multiple podium finishes on the national stage. The men's squad produced two national champions and finished sixth overall, while the women's team capitalized on every opportunity to secure a fourth-place team finish.

item.title: Carr and Young claim MSC titles as Tigers earn top-four team finishes
item.description: LOUISVILLE, Ky. — The Campbellsville University Track & Field teams made a statement Tuesday at the Mid-South Conference Indoor Championships, claiming individual titles and storming to a third-place finish on the men's side and a fourth-place showing for the women.

item.title: Tait leaps to #9, Lady Tigers tied for #17 in final NAIA Poll
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. – The National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) released the Final Women's Wrestling Coaches' Top 20 Poll of the 2025-26 season on Wednesday. Following a weekend that saw three podium finishes at the Blue Raider Open, the Campbellsville University women's wrestling team checks in tied for #17, accumulating 53 points in the national rating.
